root_idea.summary: The root develops three principal orientations: moistening and freshness, elevation or looking from above, and rendering something of little account or void.
root_idea.development: Light rain moistens and improves the earth; from visible traces and raised bodily form come طَلَلٌ for standing remains and أَطَلَّ for looking down or from above; the notion of diminishing or nullifying extends to blood or rights made to go unrecognized.

senses.definition: Light or drizzling rain; the weakest kind of rain.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic comparison, it is rain whose effect is slight, contrasted with heavy rain (وابل).

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause blood or a right to go unrecognized, uncompensated, or void; to withhold, deny, diminish, or annul a due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of blood made to go without retaliation or compensation and of a person's right or due that is withheld or denied.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To delay or put off a creditor by repeatedly promising payment later.
Rough or rigorous driving, especially of camels.
To be pleasing or goodly; pleasant, good, beautiful, or agreeable when used as an epithet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to such things as poetry, discourse, water, a night, or other objects; the examples do not impose a restriction on the object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To smear or rub a thing with ورس.
To look upon something from above, look down upon it, or obtain a view of it by raising oneself or stretching the neck.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VI usage can describe stretching the neck or standing on tiptoe to see something distant; the derived forms express the same looking-from-above construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To draw near or approach, said of time.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take possession of a right or due and carry it away.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative construction with عَلَى.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To persistently importune, molest, or annoy someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative construction, including continual persistence in causing harm or annoyance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For land to produce herbage, become full or luxuriant, and remain untrodden.
For a horse to go along raising its tail toward the sky.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move, agitate, shake, or put someone or something into motion or commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reduplicated or quadriliteral usage; moving the arms while walking is given as a related description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk; in some expressions, a small or scant quantity of milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially in expressions concerning a camel, and also in the statement that a house has no milk.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Blood itself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported lexical usage distinct from the expression for blood that has been made to go unavenged.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fat or fatness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported in an expression concerning a she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Moist, fresh, or juicy; anything characterized by moisture.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a day, land, a meadow, or other moist or fresh things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An aged man; also, an old woman or a woman foul or obscene in speech.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are reported person-designations and are not extensions of the ordinary moisture sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A serpent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare, explicitly reported usage; its relation to the principal root senses is uncertain.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used substantively.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Daintiness or delicacy in food and clothing.
The neck.
A draught of milk.
A portion still standing of the remains of a dwelling or house; in plural usage, raised or elevated remnants of a settlement or its land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term varies with dwelling type: remains of walls and worship places in settled areas, and remains of eating, drinking, or sleeping places among tent-dwellers.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The visible body, bodily form, or person of a thing; especially the erect or visible person of a man.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to what rises into view or is seen from a distance, not specifically to dwelling remains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place in a house’s courtyard or interior prepared for sitting, eating, or drinking, like a built bench.
The deck or covering of a ship or boat, like the roof of a house or chamber.
The surface or face of water.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported figurative expression meaning to walk or go upon the surface of water.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Fresh, juicy, or moist; synonymous with طَرِيٌّ.
Sweet.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A dialectal usage attributed to Hudhayl.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mat, especially one woven from palm or doum-palm leaves or their coverings.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The lexical item has several reported plural forms.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A goodly state or condition, beautiful appearance or mien, and beauty, brightness, or lustre.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Can describe the visible quality or elevated build of a person or animal, as well as the beauty of speech or appearance.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Joy, gladness, or happiness.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported meaning of the noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A chronic or permanent disease.
A calamity or misfortune.
A wearisome or intractable disease for which there is no remedy; also a disease affecting the belly or the back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The back disease is specifically reported in connection with asses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Death.
The uvula or a piece of flesh in the throat; in one account, the falling or displacement of the uvula that impedes swallowing.
Unsettled or not established.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an affair that is not stable or resolved.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Mist or thin moisture-bearing cloud covering the earth.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reported synonymic usage for a mist-like atmospheric covering.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Milk with froth or water added, appearing good or pleasant although lacking true goodness; alternatively, a piece of skin soaked and softened with pure milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The source reports alternative interpretations of the expression.

cautions: The serpent meaning is explicitly reported as anomalous and uncertain in the root-level comparison, but it is retained because the lexical entry directly attests it.
Several rare meanings are reported with variant vocalizations or alternative interpretations; those alternatives are stated in the relevant usage conditions rather than treated as Quranic senses.
